column5: - `codec/foundation_validation.rs:11215-11219`: any operation kind without its own arm gets only "result is scalar"; which kinds reach it was not listed.

- `codec/foundation_validation.rs:142-166, 372-399, 401-546`: unit 080 says unit, structural-scalar and structural calls never have their structural arguments or claim transfers checked in this file. **Corrected: does not match.** `validate_machine` runs `validate_module_invocation_entry` for every `machine.module_invocations()` (`:2331-2337`), which reaches `validate_call_tail` (`:119`) and through it `validate_structural_arguments` (`:36`) and `validate_claim_actions` (`:43`); `module_invocations` covers the five static call kinds (`TP/control_flow.rs:387-472, 524-562`).
- `:168-370`: dynamic calls: when no table has a row for the slot, arguments are checked for count only (`:228-229, 354`).
- `:10483-10503`: boundary application demands must name an existing operation, never checked to be a `BoundaryCall`.

- `:4613`: proposition variants outside the listed ones are not term-type-checked. `:3027, 3190`: zero ids tolerated as absent in proof scope. `:9210-9216, 9401-9415`: task activation: `carry_obligations` and the relation between crossings and frames unchecked.

- `codec/mathematical_proof_actual.rs:776`: `let _authorized = grants(carrier)?;` for formal actuals; the grant result is discarded and no assumption-closure check is done; reader: the formal is trusted to have been checked where first bound (not traced).
- `codec/sections.rs:95-104`: installation bytes are hashed into the manifest without decoding.

- `codec/module_wire.rs:3395`: `reader.count()? as usize`; whether `count()` is bounded was not read by unit 080 (unit 081 records `bounded_count` at `codec/wire_fields.rs:231-245` but not `count()` itself).
